source.stem:
Magnesium nitride is formed when magnesium burns in air. Magnesium nitride is an ionic compound.

What is the formula of magnesium nitride?

packed_tags.topic: Mixtures, solutions, pure substances and separation

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: A mixture is a compound because two substances are present together.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: Oxygen being necessary for living beings and combustion does not make air pure oxygen.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when Oxygen being necessary for living beings and combustion does not make air pure oxygen is not true.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: It is a mixture because you can see two colours.

intelligence.enrichment: Air is a uniform mixture made mainly of nitrogen, oxygen, argon, carbon dioxide, and water vapour; a mixture contains two or more substances mixed without undergoing a chemical change. Because several gases are present together while remaining separate substances, air is classified as a mixture rather than a single pure substance. The learner correctly applies this rule: Air is a uniform mixture made mainly of nitrogen, oxygen, argon, carbon dioxide, and water vapour; a mixture contains two or more substances mixed without undergoing a chemical change. Air is one substance because it looks invisible and uniform.
